data.name: Balefire
data.description: You call upon the cleansing or searing fires of the Outer Rifts to burn your foes. As a standard action, one target within 30 feet is wreathed in screaming flames and takes %1d6 points of fire damage.|BalefireDamageDice

raw_tokens.value: You call upon the cleansing or searing fires of the Outer Rifts to burn your foes. As a standard action, one target within 30 feet is wreathed in screaming flames and takes %1d6 points of fire damage.|BalefireDamageDice
The fire's howls cause any creatures damaged by it to be staggered for 1 round.|PREVARGTEQ:OracleLVL,10
Creatures who fail their saves against the balefire are staggered for 1d4 rounds and stunned for 1 round.|PREVARGTEQ:OracleLVL,15
